chunks: And in the narration of Sama'ah, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, he said:

I asked him about a man who was caught in the Month of Ramadan after having broken the fast three times, and had been brought before the Imam three times. He said: "Then he is executed on the third occasion."

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the legitimate authority before whom the case is presented
key_terms.سَمَاعَةَ: Sama'ah, the narrator transmitting this hadith
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the Month of Ramadan, the obligatory period of sawm (fasting)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone who repeatedly breaks the fast publicly in Ramadan and is brought before the Imam three times?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person who repeatedly and openly breaks the fast in the Month of Ramadan and is brought before the Imam multiple times. It indicates escalating punishment in the judicial sphere, culminating in execution on the third offense.
